mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the uniqueness fact lets two distinct AuditEntry atoms share the same ofOp, which is exactly the duplicate/rewrite scenario AppendOnly forbids and which also breaks the 'one' multiplicity in AuditCompleteness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAudit { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.ofOp = ae2.ofOp }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the boundary fact, Alloy can invent an Operation that has no caller yet does not have outcome=Unauthenticated, i.e., business logic ran without authentication.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthBypass { some op: Operation | no op.caller and op.outcome != Unauthenticated }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the care-team gate lets a Permitted LookupPatient exist without any CareTeamMembership row tying the caller to the requested patient — exactly the FR-006 violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BypassCareTeam { some op: Operation | op.kind = LookupPatient and op.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.member = op.caller and m.forPatient = op.requested) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the outcome-to-visible mapping permits an Operation whose outcome is Denied to surface a non-NotFound404 response, which would leak the existence of the patient to a non-care-team clinician.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakViaResponse { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Denied and op.visible != NotFound404 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the least-privilege fact, Alloy can produce a Permitted operation whose (role, kind) pair is not in PermMatrix.Allowed — e.g., an audit_officer succeeding at LookupPatient, or a doctor succeeding at AuditSearch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeBypass { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Permitted and (op.caller.role -> op.kind) not in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the audit-on-lookup fact lets a Permitted LookupPatient operation exist with zero AuditEntry rows pointing at it — exactly the 'record observed without matching audit entry' failure SC-002 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some op: Operation | op.kind = LookupPatient and some op.caller and op.bodyValid = BTrue and op.outcome = Permitted and (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.ofOp = op) }
